findings.disposition: Repaired. AI Enter calls production `ai_boot` and submits the typed prompt unless history was deliberately selected. Empty AI opens a new chat. `/dir` resolves through a ticket-owned reply before boot; errors preserve input. Terminal effects distinguish command/new session from selected session. Edits, Hide, composition start and backend epoch retire submit ownership. Composition cancels deferred Enter.
findings.evidence_and_gates: `opus_h1_*`, `opus_ime_cancels_deferred_enter_before_async_result`, `opus_ai_history_selection_cannot_transfer_to_refreshed_first_row`; M5 must execute the explicit effects and acknowledge them. Real focus/IME/provider/PTY work is a native gate.

findings.disposition: Repaired. Ordered JSON object visitor uses a `HashMap<String,usize>`: last value, first position. Both direct JSON formatting and clipboard JSON parse once into that tree. Clipboard conversion is a worker intent, not a synchronous controller call. 1 MiB bound retained.
findings.evidence_and_gates: `opus_json_duplicate_order_large_objects_scaling`, `opus_clipboard_transform_is_off_thread_and_selection_owned`; 40k and 100k keys round-trip without loss; no timing threshold.

findings.disposition: Repaired. `Invalidate { text }` filters against current request input or `ArgumentValue`, excludes Deep, retains caches, and records hidden dirtiness. Show schedules one refresh.
findings.evidence_and_gates: `opus_m1_invalidation_payload_deep_hidden_and_cache`.

findings.disposition: Repaired. Backend change retires activation/resolution and old transport ownership before refreshing. Ticket identities prevent old completion from releasing a newer activation.
findings.evidence_and_gates: `opus_m2_backend_retires_activation_and_stale_completion_cannot_unlock_new`. Transport executors must report terminal success/error; restart no longer depends on that old callback.

findings.disposition: Repaired. Explicit and successful hides share `reset_hidden`, clearing input, composition draft, list/session selection, argument and terminal mode.
findings.evidence_and_gates: `opus_m3_all_hides_reset_input_composition_and_mode`, existing interrupted-IME test.

findings.disposition: Repaired with explicit authority policy. A Basic query of exactly one **UTF-16 unit** completes locally after the fixed coalescing window. Its filtered cache rows become current-generation authority; pending speculative rows never authorize clicks. Astral characters have length two and retain backend search.
findings.evidence_and_gates: `opus_m4_one_utf16_unit_has_local_authority_and_stale_click_fails`; metadata length thresholds also use UTF-16.

findings.disposition: Repaired: JS unary-left-of-exponent rejection, `**` and `^`, degree expansion as multiplication, NaN propagation in min/max and exact half-boundary round. Bounded grammar decision: leading-zero literals remain decimal (`010+1` = 11), and comma expressions are rejected; function argument commas remain supported. Sloppy-JS octal and the general JS comma operator are deliberately outside this arithmetic language.
findings.evidence_and_gates: `opus_calculator_js_edges`, original calculator cases, Node reference. No eval or JS runtime.

findings.disposition: Repaired. The existing html5ever tokenizer now handles markup structurally: comments/doctype/processing instructions/unknown and namespaced tags are dropped; quoted `>` and incomplete attributes follow tokenizer states. Script/style contents are suppressed in raw-text states. Allowed tags and decoded text are canonicalized to the stored subset; no DOM, WebView, scripting or I/O.
findings.evidence_and_gates: `opus_html_structural_tokens`, `opus_jsdom_office_webkit_structural_reference`, unchanged formatting/list/undo/entity tests. HTML corpus includes Office comments, namespace markup, WebKit paste, malformed quotes, lists and active content. This is a stored subset, not a general HTML DOM implementation.

findings.disposition: Repaired. Hot regexes use Rust-1.85-compatible `LazyLock`; Markdown patterns compile once. Notes list caches plain text by note ID + `updated_at` revision and invalidates on load/save/create/delete. Drafts retain serialized HTML by revision; each edit computes the new serialization once, and idle ticks only compare cached strings. Bounds compute escaped length without serializing a second document.
findings.evidence_and_gates: `opus_notes_revision_cache_and_idle_tick_scaling`; source inspection of `cached_regex!` and static Markdown rules; both toolchains pass. Public direct row mutation must advance `updated_at`, as core does; normal controller completions invalidate explicitly.

findings.disposition: Parent repair retained. Settings → General, Providers → AI; all three updater IDs → single status-dependent `UpdateAction`.
findings.evidence_and_gates: Four parent regressions remain green in combined suite. M5 resolves current updater state, not the command spelling.

findings.disposition: Repaired. Original 170-case map retained; harness calls production `input_mode`, `ai_boot`, `parse_search_query`, `deep_search_input`, `deep_search_draft_input`, `UiState::record_launcher_query` and `UiState::import_key`. Harness only adapts fixture wire shapes and numeric/default comparisons.
findings.evidence_and_gates: 170 TS cases pass, mapped Rust cases pass; machine map includes production bindings. No source test weakened or removed. The old IME search test now uses two BMP characters to retain its backend-ownership intent under M4; all six prototype cases and four parent cases retained.

findings.disposition: Repaired at model boundary. `Timestamp`, `RelativeTime`, `ClipboardCount` expose structured values; `PresentationFormatter` injects local timestamp, relative text and number formatting. English fallback uses actual local timezone, `last week`/`next month`/`last year`, and grouped counts.
findings.evidence_and_gates: `opus_locale_structured_data_and_injected_formatter`. Native OS locale formatter remains an explicit M5/M6 adapter acceptance gate, including non-English locale and timezone tests. No OS formatter was exercised here.

findings.disposition: Repaired. JSON finite numbers use f64 + production `instant::number`: integral decimals/exponents, negative zero and large integer rounding match JS. JS whitespace/BOM trimming accepted. Exceeding the 128-level or finite-number bound returns an explicit error from clipboard conversion; it cannot silently encode the document as a string. Ordinary non-JSON clipboard text still intentionally becomes a JSON string.
findings.evidence_and_gates: `opus_json_js_numbers_bom_and_depth`, duplicate/order/scale test, Node reference. Explicit bound: non-finite numeric literals such as `1e400` error rather than silently losing them as JS stringify's null.

findings.disposition: Repaired. File and image entries load previews; `image_preview_loaded` accepts null and caches null/error/over-budget results. Eight-entry / 16 MiB cache and 8 MiB per preview bounds remain. Secure items do not request previews.
findings.evidence_and_gates: `opus_clipboard_file_negative_preview_filter_clamp`. Adapter may supply a bounded thumbnail; real clipboard/thumbnail behavior not run.

findings.disposition: Repaired. Query/filter fields are private with setters that clamp selection and clear conversion ownership. Index-based selection matches TS. Late transforms are dropped after selection changes.
findings.evidence_and_gates: Clipboard regression tests; public read accessors retained.

findings.disposition: Repaired. Compact fallback and whole-left fallback added; tokenizer matches the TS Latin/Russian character class, including replacement of Kazakh `ң`; percent rejection applies only to the left side. Removed unsupported extra Thai-symbol prefix/suffix extraction while retaining TS symbol tokenization.
findings.evidence_and_gates: `opus_currency_compact_fallback_script_and_percent_side`, original ten parser cases.

findings.identity: L04 UI-state decoding / import / Windows writer
findings.disposition: Parent defaults/type/version/unknown-field repair retained. Legacy numeric pin IDs and null subtitles import; emoji and extension recents trim. Windows sharing/lock violations retry at most five times (150 ms total delay) without deleting the destination; other errors fail immediately.
findings.evidence_and_gates: `opus_legacy_pins_numeric_null_and_trimmed_recents`, `opus_windows_sharing_retry_is_bounded_and_other_errors_immediate`, atomic TempDir fixture. Windows retry policy is simulated on macOS; real sharing semantics and inherited ACLs remain platform gates, not claimed as verified. Unix 0600 behavior retained.

findings.disposition: Repaired despite the same race existing in TS. Write records draft owner separately from revision. Concurrent saves for the same owner are blocked; `write_completed(request, Result<String,String>)` adopts the created ID into a newer revision of that same draft. New/cancelled/different drafts cannot adopt it. Validation matches core's Unicode lowercase and CRLF/UTF-16 rules.
findings.evidence_and_gates: `opus_snippet_create_adopts_id_for_newer_revision_and_unicode_uniqueness`, `opus_snippet_late_create_cannot_adopt_into_different_draft`. Core remains store authority.

findings.disposition: Repaired. Empty copy emits `Message("Note is empty")`, never `Copy("")`. Revision-cached HTML removes repeated full serialization from edits and idle ticks.
findings.evidence_and_gates: `opus_empty_note_copy`, note scaling regression, existing undo/autosave tests.

findings.disposition: Intentional documented policy: search visible plain text, not raw HTML. Invisible tags/comments/entities are not search terms. This improves the native surface; stored rich HTML remains compatible.
findings.evidence_and_gates: Notes revision-cache regression and HTML corpus. No claim of raw-HTML-search equivalence.
